paragraphs.text: Sky Tyrant was the red moon of Mirrodin that shone over the Oxidda Chain . It was composed of red mana .

Mirrodin's Goblins assigned great significance to the sun as they see red wavelengths of light most strongly. For them, Sky Tyrant was the brightest object in the sky. They believed that the Sky Tyrant was the mighty hammer that forged the body of the Steel Mother , and that blinkmoths were the sparks from the forge. They hosted wild festivals whenever the sun was directly above Kuldotha , its lacunae .
It now orbits Zhalfir after New Phyrexia's phasing out at the end of the New Phyrexian Invasion .
